scope: Durable single-owner Dispatch plunder worker wired to the R7-081 persistence kernel and R7-082 current-v19 executor. Public scheduling and live plunder remain blocked.

recoveredAuthority.armableRead: scheduled|waiting_connection, plunder_at <= now + 10000, unexpired, plunder_at ASC LIMIT 1
recoveredAuthority.offlineDue: scheduled and plunder_at <= now -> waiting_connection / DISPATCH_PLUNDER_GAME_DISCONNECTED; arm lead is not used

currentV19SafetyPolicy.restartReason: after a host restart the current-v19 replacement cannot prove whether DispatchSteal had already been sent; making the job retryable could duplicate a real plunder
currentV19SafetyPolicy.guardedRunningTransition: only scheduled|waiting_connection may enter running; clears error and increments attempts exactly once
currentV19SafetyPolicy.guardedRunningReason: prevents a cancel/reschedule race from resurrecting a terminal or cancelled row after armable read
currentV19SafetyPolicy.crossServer: worker does not require current live server == target server; current-v19 DispatchSteal carries targetServer and R7-082 executor rechecks IsOpenCrossSteal()
currentV19SafetyPolicy.postRunningUnknown: cancellation, state-unknown, ambiguous or unknown executor failure terminalizes to failed / DISPATCH_PLUNDER_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT and is never retried

worker.operationOwnership: shared serialized Map Data game-operation gate with scans, navigation, Treasure inspection and Truck plunder
worker.loopCadence: 1 second implementation policy; eligibility remains governed by recovered 10-second lead

stateMachine: expire active due-expired rows before selecting work
no live game connection: move due scheduled rows to waiting_connection without using arm lead
read one armable scheduled|waiting_connection row within 10-second lead
validate exact task UUID/server/timing identity before attempt
guarded active-only running transition with one attempt increment
execute target server/task UUID/plunderAt through R7-082 internal current-v19 executor
daily-limit rejection -> fail current row then fail all remaining active Dispatch jobs
pre-send connection loss proven by executor + live connection now absent -> waiting_connection
pre-send arm timeout while still connected -> failed
safety: No Dispatch steal/plunder, Truck robbery, Treasure claim, alliance/message send, collection, consumable, or other state-changing live gameplay action was executed.
